answer: In Pennsylvania, choosing limited tort lowers your premium but means you can recover medical and out-of-pocket costs after a crash while generally giving up the right to sue for pain and suffering, unless an exception such as a serious injury applies [s:pa-auto-insurance-guide#3].

citations.title: Automobile Insurance Guide
citations.excerpt: Under limited tort you may seek recovery for medical and out-of-pocket expenses, but not for pain and suffering unless the injuries meet the serious-injury threshold.
